title: Formal causes: debido a and a raíz de

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know formal cause connectors like *debido a* and *a raíz de* from B1 Unit 6. They give the reason or the starting point of something, and they sound written and historical. A noun follows them.

items.spanish: Debido a la concentración de la tierra, muchos campesinos no tenían tierra propia.
items.english: Because of the concentration of land, many peasants had no land of their own.

items.spanish: A raíz de la revolución de 1952, Bolivia hizo una reforma agraria.
items.english: As a result of the revolution of 1952, Bolivia carried out a land reform.

items.spanish: Debido a esas reformas, algunos grandes propietarios se opusieron al gobierno.
items.english: Because of those reforms, some big landowners opposed the government.

items.spanish: A raíz de estos conflictos, la discusión sobre la tierra era también una discusión sobre el poder.
items.english: As a result of these conflicts, the discussion about land was also a discussion about power.

sections.content: After *debido a* and *a raíz de* put a noun phrase (*debido a la concentración*), not a verb. To use a verb, say *debido a que* + verb. Start the sentence with the phrase and put a comma after the noun phrase.
